document_understanding.document_overview: This Excel document outlines the architecture and workflow of an agentic quality engineering (QE) pipeline. It details each phase of the pipeline, the responsible agent roles, their purposes, and the key outputs produced at each stage. The document is structured as a single sheet with a comprehensive table that captures the sequential flow of the QE process.

sheet_summaries.summary: This sheet presents a structured table describing the four main phases of the agentic QE pipeline: Ingestion & Parsing, Scenario Planning, Test Authoring, and Publishing. For each phase, the table specifies the agent role involved, the purpose of the phase, and the key outputs generated. This provides a clear, stepwise understanding of how requirements are transformed into published test cases through agent-driven automation.

important_points: The pipeline is divided into four main phases, each handled by a dedicated agent.
Ingestion & Parsing phase focuses on collecting and normalizing user story data.
Scenario Planning identifies test coverage scenarios, producing a scenario matrix.
Test Authoring converts scenarios into detailed test cases with steps and expected results.
Publishing phase pushes finalized test cases to the repository for use in automation.

document_understanding.final_conclusion: The document provides a clear and systematic overview of an agentic QE pipeline, emphasizing automation and agent roles at each stage. It serves as a concise reference for understanding the workflow from requirement ingestion to test case publication, with all key steps and outputs explicitly detailed in a single, well-structured table.
